name: node-project-template
description: A repository template for node projects.

scripts.check: npm run check-format && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run coverage

scripts-info.dev:frontend: Run the frontend app in development mode
scripts-info.lint:frontend: Run ESLint for the frontend workspace
scripts-info.format: Auto-format all project files with Prettier
scripts-info.check-format: Check if project files meet Prettier formatting standards
scripts-info.test: Run unit tests and write results to reports/test-results.json
scripts-info.coverage: Run test coverage and write results to reports/coverage-summary.json
scripts-info.check: Run code formatting check, linting, unit tests, and coverage analysis
scripts-info.install-hooks: Install prek git hooks in the repository
